content: Header patterns for fashion/streetwear: logo linked to home; centered-logo layouts read as premium for fashion; hamburger-first minimal header is the easiest responsive pattern (desktop behaves like mobile) with full-screen overlay; sticky header common with hide-on-scroll-down/show-on-scroll-up; announcement bar above header is its own section with rotating messages; tap targets 48x48 min; Supreme anti-marketing homepage (logo + timestamp + lowercase link stack) shows minimal nav is a viable streetwear pattern.
